metadata.author: LivingPatch Contributors
metadata.description: Florida species dataset: mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, invertebrates, plants, and fungi with hierarchical taxonomic grouping

species.functional_description: Small rabbit found in open fields and brushy areas. Important prey for raptors and carnivorous mammals.
Medium-sized rodent of grasslands and marshes. Prolific breeder providing food for snakes and raptors.
Small rabbit specialized for wetland habitats. Excellent swimmer adapted to Florida marshes.
Small arboreal mouse found in various habitats from pine forests to swamps.
Rat-sized rodent that builds elaborate stick nests. Found in forests and rocky outcrops.
Burrowing rodent creating extensive tunnel systems in sandy soils. Creates habitat structure for other species.
species.keystone_description: Creates burrow systems used by other species; disturbed soil affects plant communities.

species.functional_description: Endemic to Florida. Specialized for scrubby pine forests and palmetto flatwoods.
Tiny shrew hunting insects and small invertebrates in grasslands.
Venomous shrew hunting small vertebrates and invertebrates.
Armored mammal that digs for insects and invertebrates. Creates burrows and disturbs soil.
Beautiful golden-colored mouse that forages in trees and shrubs.
Semi-aquatic rodent of Florida marshes and wetlands.
Small vole that creates underground burrows and tunnels.
Pale-colored mouse of open fields and scrublands.
Burrowing mole hunting earthworms and soil invertebrates.
Semi-aquatic rodent of marshes and grasslands.
Black and white mustelid with potent defensive spray. Omnivorous predator of small animals and grubs.
Intelligent masked mammal. Omnivorous predator of crayfish, frogs, small mammals, and invertebrates.
species.keystone_description: Controls populations of crayfish, frogs, and small mammals; impacts water quality through disturbance.

species.functional_description: Small canid that can climb trees. Hunts small mammals and birds.
Slender mustelid predator hunting small mammals and birds.
Medium-sized wild cat. Apex predator of rabbits, rodents, and small mammals.
species.keystone_description: Controls rabbit and small mammal populations; maintains ecosystem balance.

species.functional_description: Red canid predator hunting small mammals, rabbits, and invertebrates.
Only marsupial in North America. Adaptable omnivore that plays dead when threatened.
Smaller spotted skunk with potent defense. Hunts insects and small invertebrates.
Semi-aquatic mustelid predator of fish, frogs, and small mammals.
Playful aquatic mustelid predator of fish and crayfish.
species.keystone_description: Aquatic apex predator; controls fish and crayfish populations.

species.functional_description: Adaptable canid predator hunting small to medium mammals.
Tree-climbing mustelid that hunts porcupines and other small mammals.
Invasive feral cat. Significant predator of birds and small mammals.
Invasive feral dog. Pack hunters that prey on various wildlife.
Large omnivorous bear. Opportunistic feeder on plants, insects, and small animals.
species.keystone_description: Distributes seeds and shapes plant communities through foraging.

species.functional_description: Critically endangered large felid. Apex predator of deer and wild boar.
species.keystone_description: Apex predator controlling herbivore populations; critically endangered with fewer than 200 individuals.

species.functional_description: Ground-nesting quail of grasslands and scrublands. Depends on longleaf pine understory.
Yellow-breasted songbird of open grasslands. Iconic grassland specialist.
Rufous songbird that forages in dense vegetation. Excellent mimic.
Rare grassland sparrow dependent on longleaf pine ecosystems.
Aerial insectivore hunting insects at dusk. Ground nester.
Large game bird that forages on forest floor. Roosts in trees.
Small plover with distinctive broken-wing display. Ground nester of open areas.
Ground-foraging woodpecker that hunts ants. Excavates cavities in soft wood.
Small sparrow of open grasslands. Distinctive pink bill.
Tiny grassland sparrow. Ground nester that forages for insects.
Small sparrow of grasslands and marshes.
Yellow warbler of pine forests. Year-round resident in southeastern pines.
Aggressive flycatcher that hunts insects in flight. Nests near water.
Bright red cardinal. Common year-round resident of scrubby areas.
Brilliant blue bunting. Males sing from exposed perches in scrubland.
Bright blue thrush. Cavity nester that forages for insects on open ground.
Forest hawk with red shoulder patch. Hunts small mammals and reptiles.
species.keystone_description: Controls small mammal and reptile populations in forest habitats.

species.functional_description: Smallest falcon. Hunts insects, small birds, and rodents from open perches.
Largest owl. Night hunter of small mammals. Year-round resident.
species.keystone_description: Apex nocturnal predator controlling small mammal populations.

species.functional_description: Small owl with distinctive whinny call. Nocturnal hunter of small animals.
Large forest owl with distinctive 'who cooks for you' call. Hunts small mammals.
Large hawk with red tail. Open-area hunter of small mammals.
species.keystone_description: Apex daytime predator controlling rodent and rabbit populations.

species.functional_description: Large eagle with white head. Fish hunter near water bodies.
species.keystone_description: Apex aquatic predator; recovered from near extinction.

species.functional_description: Agile woodland hawk that hunts small birds.
Forest hawk that hunts small mammals and reptiles.
Graceful aerial insectivore with forked tail. Hunts insects while soaring.
Smallest hawk. Hunts small songbirds in dense vegetation.
Fish-hunting raptor that plunges into water. Near-global distribution.
Grassland hawk that hunts low over open areas for small mammals.
Dark soaring vulture that feeds on carrion. Highly olfactory.
All-black vulture. Carrion feeder that soars in thermals.
Fastest bird alive. Hunts other birds in high-speed pursuits.
species.keystone_description: Apex avian predator; recovered from near extinction.

species.functional_description: Predatory songbird that hunts insects and small vertebrates.
Red-eyed towhee that forages on the ground.
Large wren with loud song. Cavity nester of scrubby areas.
Beautiful woodpecker with all-red head. Cavity excavator.
Excellent mimic with diverse song. Year-round resident.
Gray dove with mournful cooing call. Ground feeder.
Blue-gray kingfisher that hunts fish from perches. Cavity nester.
Intelligent blue jay. Seed disperser and vocal communicator.
Black corvid with high intelligence. Omnivorous opportunist.
Smaller corvid specialized for aquatic areas.
Small vireo that gleans insects from foliage.
Pine specialist that forages on bark. Cooperative breeder.
Smallest woodpecker. Bark forager and cavity nester.
Larger woodpecker. Bark forager and cavity excavator.
Largest woodpecker. Creates large rectangular cavities.
species.keystone_description: Creates large cavities used by owls, kestrels, and other species.

species.functional_description: Common fence-climbing lizard. Insect hunter.
Fast lizard with six light stripes. Ground dweller.
Common skink with five light lines. Fast and agile.
Scrub habitat specialist. Threatened by habitat loss.
Green lizard that changes color. Tree-climber.
Invasive lizard from Caribbean. Outcompetes native anole.
Large skink. Males have reddish heads. Tree climber.
Tiny skink of leaf litter.
Small brown skink of moist areas.
Sandy soil specialist. Secretive burrower.
Legless lizard. Preys on snakes and other reptiles.
Slender legless lizard. Preys on small reptiles.
Large aggressive lizard with collar marking. Eats other lizards.
Small sandy-area lizard without external ears.
Spiny-backed lizard of rocky habitats.
Endemic to Florida. Sandy soil specialist with reduced limbs.
Large glossy snake. Eats other snakes including venomous ones.
Large venomous rattlesnake. Threatened by habitat loss.
species.keystone_description: Apex predator of small mammals; threatened species.

species.functional_description: Burrowing snake of pine habitats. Hunts small mammals.
Fast active snake. Hunts lizards and small snakes.
Common striped snake. Hunts small animals near water.
Beautiful patterned snake. Small mammal hunter.
Fast black snake. Hunts small reptiles and mammals.
Banded snake that eats other snakes including venomous ones.
Green snake that hunts insects in vegetation.
Beautiful banded snake. Mimics coral snake. Eats other snakes.
Venomous water snake. Hunts fish and small animals.
Venomous pit viper. Hunts small mammals.
Venomous pit viper of forested areas.
Highly venomous but reclusive snake. Red, yellow, black banding.
Small secretive snake with neck ring.
Tree-climbing snake that hunts rodents. Beneficial.
Domed turtle of upland habitats. Eats plants and invertebrates.
Burrowing tortoise of sandy areas. Creates burrows used by 300+ species.
species.keystone_description: Creates burrow system used by over 300 vertebrate and invertebrate species.

species.functional_description: Small aquatic turtle of freshwater habitats.
Striped aquatic turtle of freshwater wetlands.
Aggressive aquatic turtle with soft shell.
Salt marsh specialist. Threatened by crab trap drowning.
Small spotted turtle of freshwater wetlands.
Large aggressive turtle with powerful jaws.
Large aquatic turtle with powerful jaws and lure.
Colorful basking turtle of freshwater habitats.
Florida endemic basking turtle.
Aquatic turtle of shallow wetlands.
Small aquatic turtle with musky odor defense.
Small aquatic turtle with musk gland defense.
Aquatic softshell turtle with spiny shell.
Florida endemic basking turtle.

taxonomic_groups.label: Small Mammals
taxonomic_groups.common_traits: Small rodents, shrews, and other small mammals; important prey for raptors and predators; seed dispersers
taxonomic_groups.notes: Rodentia, Soricomorpha; includes rabbits, rats, mice, shrews, moles

taxonomic_groups.label: Predatory Mammals
taxonomic_groups.common_traits: Carnivorous and omnivorous mammals; predators of small animals; keystone species in many ecosystems
taxonomic_groups.notes: Carnivora; includes mustelids, felids, canids, ursids

taxonomic_groups.label: Ground-Nesting Birds
taxonomic_groups.common_traits: Birds that nest on the ground; grassland and scrubland specialists; depend on open habitats
taxonomic_groups.notes: Various orders; includes quail, meadowlarks, sparrows, nighthawks

taxonomic_groups.label: Raptors
taxonomic_groups.common_traits: Birds of prey; apex and secondary predators; cavity nesters or open nesters; hunt birds, mammals, and reptiles
taxonomic_groups.notes: Falconiformes, Strigiformes; eagles, hawks, owls, falcons, kites

taxonomic_groups.label: Other Birds
taxonomic_groups.common_traits: Diverse songbirds and other species; varied diets and habitats; important seed dispersers and insect controllers
taxonomic_groups.notes: Various orders; includes woodpeckers, corvids, warblers, kingfishers, wrens

taxonomic_groups.label: Lizards
taxonomic_groups.common_traits: Scaled reptiles; mostly insectivorous; diurnal and cryptic species; threatened by habitat loss
taxonomic_groups.notes: Squamata; includes skinks, anoles, glass lizards, fence lizards

taxonomic_groups.label: Snakes
taxonomic_groups.common_traits: Legless reptiles; ophiophagous and rodent hunters; venomous and non-venomous species; important predators
taxonomic_groups.notes: Squamata, Serpentes; includes rattlesnakes, kingsnakes, water snakes, rat snakes

taxonomic_groups.label: Turtles and Other Reptiles
taxonomic_groups.common_traits: Armored reptiles; aquatic and terrestrial species; long-lived; keystone ecosystem engineers
taxonomic_groups.notes: Testudines; includes box turtles, terapins, cooters, mud turtles, snappers
